findings.issue: Next-slot search now loops in batches until the horizon (2000 candidates per batch, up to 2 reads per batch). The spec AC-016 states a bounded query count (<= 5 queries); with batching the read count grows with the horizon. One test covers the multi-batch path (test file line 330); I did not see a test asserting an upper bound on total reads for a long horizon.
findings.fix: Confirm the worst-case batch count for the maximum horizon is acceptable and, if AC-016's bound still matters, add an assertion on total read count for a full-horizon empty search.
